answer: An hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The falcon schedule is applied in forge and gale shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 21% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4211 identities would post 2064 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
